commit.message:
peer: reestablish pending channels on reconnect

BOLT 2 requires a node to send channel_reestablish for every
remembered channel when a peer reconnects. Pending channels are remembered
but have no link, so lnd previously sent nothing until funding confirmed. A
peer waiting for the message could disconnect the shared connection.

Queue the message while loading pending channels and record the handoff so
the link created after confirmation still processes the remote state without
sending a duplicate.

Add regression coverage for the pending funding-node case.

Signed-off-by: Vincenzo Palazzo <vincenzopalazzodev@gmail.com>

commit.message:
ci: scope lint reports to the change base

Use the checked-out merge commit's first parent as the lint reporting
base for PR and merge-group jobs, following the release-note checks.
Pass the same optional override to root and submodule lint so existing
warnings outside the change no longer fail unrelated PRs.

Keep nightly runs on the configured baseline and preserve native
lint's existing merge-base override. Full package analysis still runs.

commit.message:
lint: allow more time for CI analysis

Package loading can consume nine minutes of the existing ten-minute
budget on CI runners, leaving too little time for lint analysis.
Increase the total-work limit to fifteen minutes while keeping it
bounded and preserving all lint checks.

commit.message:
invoices: reject stale shards at set completion

Revalidate every accepted MPP or AMP shard when a completing shard
arrives. If an existing shard no longer satisfies either CLTV delta,
cancel the accepted set, keep the invoice open, and reject the
completing shard without recording it.
